SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(m.id) AS media_count, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM tag t LEFT JOIN media m ON LOCATE( CONCAT('|', t.name, '|'), CONCAT('|', COALESCE(m.tags, ''), '|') ) > 0
t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.created_at, t.updated_at ORDER BY t.name, t.id

SELECT t.name FROM tag t INNER JOIN ( SELECT ranked.tags, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ranked.favorite_count DESC, ranked.like_count DESC, ranked.view_count DESC, ranked.id DESC ) AS media_rank FROM media ranked WHERE ranked.status = 1
AND ( ranked.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ranked.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ranked.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY ranked.favorite_count DESC, ranked.like_count DESC, ranked.view_count DESC, ranked.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) candidate ON LOCATE( CONCAT('|', t.name, '|'), CONCAT('|', COALESCE(candidate.tags, ''), '|') ) > 0
t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY MIN(candidate.media_rank), MIN(LOCATE(t.name, candidate.tags)), t.id LIMIT #{limit}
